messages.campaign_fixture.quest.structures.title: Campaign fixture: generated waystation
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.structures.descri: Find a waystation generated by this test datapack in a new chunk. Meet its dedicated keeper.
This waystation was created when this chunk first generated. Its marker and keeper give the campaign a shared destination.
campaign_fixture.quest.structures.remind: Walk to the marked waystation. Buildings in explored chunks will not be replaced.
campaign_fixture.quest.structures.report: You returned to the same waystation keeper. Reloading the world keeps this destination.
